THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
NIGHT & LIFESTYLE
166
STUDY 155
Dark Leather Jacket on a Parisian Balcony
Rights check
Source: 25058.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight blonde hair
and wispy bangs stands on a balcony with ornate black
wrought-iron railings. She wears a dark brown leather
zip jacket with a high collar, patch pockets, and a short
black skirt, with a black shoulder bag strap across her
body. Gold rings adorn her fingers. Her expression is
calm and serious, looking off to the side. Warm,
late-afternoon light on a cream stone facade. Palette of
espresso brown, black, and warm gold. Chic and
candid, in the style of an urban street-style photo.
Chic, urban, candid
WORKING NOTES
- The leather jacket and ornate railing set the mood.
- Keep the stone facade for a Parisian setting.
